title: studio → pipelines: start a batch
description: Studio's outbox relay publishes it on subject `cmd.pipeline.submit` (stream CMD) in the transaction that changes the batch; Nats-Msg-Id `<batch_id>:<n>`, n = the batch's command counter (submit = 1, +1 per later command). pipelines_service consumes it (durable `pipelines`, filter `cmd.pipeline.>`, one message at a time, in order). Carries the whole snapshot: pipelines stores it and never reads the registry or the live workflow. A second delivery of the same batch is harmless (it continues the batch it already has).

session_id.description: the session the batch's runs are made in

pipeline.description: present for a batch of a saved pipeline (API 1.7): what the batch runs. workflow_id / workflow are then its first step's (one of pipeline.workflows)

snapshot.description: what the batch runs, as it was at Submit: one workflow (graph node `step`), or with `pipeline` a saved pipeline

inputs.description: the base inputs, applied to every row (already merged into each row's inputs)

rows.description: every row, in order (row 1 first); seeds already drawn

inputs.description: the row's full inputs: base inputs, then the row's values, then its seed; sent as is to studio.runs.create; a pipeline batch: `<inputs node>.<input>` → value, every input set

seeds.description: pipeline batches: step node id → the row's base seed for that step (every step with a seed_param); run i of visit v of row attempt a uses (base + (a − 1) × 64 + v × seeds + i) mod 2^53

replay_from.description: from API 1.14, Run again with the same decisions: the batch whose decisions are reused (replay keys with that batch id); absent = decide again. The snapshot and rows (seeds included) are the source batch's
